summary: Check whether ḥəlfi transposes the consonants of the first-person Preterit.
rationale: The entry gives the Preterit base ḥəfle and examples ḥəfle/ḥəffe. In the personal-communication example, ḥəlfi has l before f, suggesting a transposition for ḥəfli. No source verse or independent first-person attestation is supplied, so this is a question, not an established correction.
